collectedButNotYetMerged.blockedBy: schema has no admissionGate field; Gillings programs are limited-enrollment with sophomore-year application
admission-gated, and major work may be satisfied at NC State - needs a cross-institution course source, not UNC codes only

expansionOrder: The other four Gillings B.S.P.H. programs as distinct records: Biostatistics, Environmental Health Sciences, Health Policy and Management, Nutrition
The three EXSS B.A. tracks, captured separately - the existing record is the B.S. only
Pre-health adjacent: Clinical Laboratory Science, Environmental Science B.S., Statistics and Analytics B.S., Medical Anthropology B.A., Sociology B.A., Physics B.S.
Full catalog A-Z only after the schema supports source versioning, tracks, admission gates, and option/exclusion logic
schemaGapsBlockingExpansion: track - Nutrition has two tracks (Nutrition Health and Society; Nutrition Science and Research). UNC describes the Science and Research track as med-school preparation. One flat record cannot hold both.
admissionGate - B.S.P.H. and BME require a separate application; university admission does not grant program admission.
catalogYear per record - meta.curriculumVersion is file-wide. The 2026-2027 IDEAs page applies to students beginning Fall 2026; earlier cohorts need archived catalog editions.
option-group logic - the catalog uses choose-one, choose-two, minimum-credit, area-breadth, course-number-range, exclusion and no-double-count rules. A flat course list produces false completions.
majorScope.boundary: Planning library only. UNC states the official graduation audit is the student's ConnectCarolina record; this data can show what the catalog says for a selected program and cohort, never that a student is cleared to graduate.
majorScope.openDefect: meta.appliesTo claims 'matriculating Fall 2022 or later', but the research packet finds the current IDEAs page applies specifically to students beginning Fall 2026, with earlier cohorts directed to catalog archives. These cannot both be right - needs verification before any completion calculation ships.

meta.producedBy: Merged: gen-ed + med prereqs + Neuroscience verified live by Claude (catalog.unc.edu); other 5 majors from ChatGPT (sources normalized, flagged for spot-check)
meta.verificationNote: ChatGPT's gen-ed drifted to the retired 2022 curriculum (e.g. 'Power, Difference, and Inequality', Triple-I). This merge uses Claude's live-verified gen-ed instead. ChatGPT's majors are included for breadth but carry verificationStatus='needs spot-check'.
